Pooling is the quiet workhorse of a CNN:.zh:
池化是 CNN 中默默承担重任的构件：它通过对每个小窗口
      取一个数值来缩小特征图。滑动下方的窗口，观察
      输出网格如何逐格填充 — @@T0@@最大值@@T1@@ 保留每个
      图块中最强的激活，@@T2@@平均值@@T3@@ 则将其平滑。输出尺寸亦非谜团；
      一个下取整公式便能精确预测它。
Pooling is the quiet workhorse of a CNN:.src: Pooling is the quiet workhorse of a CNN: it shrinks a feature map by summarising each little window with a single number. Slide the window below and watch the output grid fill in — max keeps the strongest activation in each patch, average smooths it. The output size is no mystery either; one floor formula predicts it exactly.

@@T0@@~7 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Lea.zh:
@@T0@@约 7 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · CNN · 下采样@@T3@@

Slide the window, watch the output.src: Slide the window, watch the output

A $6\\times6$ feature map sits on the le.zh:
左侧是一个 $6\times6$ 的特征图。一个尺寸为 $K$ 的池化窗口
      以步长 $S$ 在其上滑动；每次停留都会在右侧产生一个数值。可逐步
      遍历各位置，或按下播放。左侧高亮的图块即
      当前窗口；右侧带描边的格子即它产生的数值。在
      @@T0@@最大值@@T1@@ 模式下，胜出的输入单元标有星号。
A $6\\times6$ feature map sits on the le.src: A $6\times6$ feature map sits on the left. A pooling window of size $K$ slides across it with stride $S$; each landing produces one number on the right. Step through the positions, or press play. The highlighted patch on the left is the current window; the outlined cell on the right is the number it produces. In max mode the winning input cell is starred.

Left: the input feature map with the liv.zh: 左：带实时池化窗口的输入特征图。右：输出特征图，逐格填充。
Left: the input feature map with the liv.src: Left: the input feature map with the live pooling window. Right: the output map, filling one cell at a time.

@@T0@@Current window &rarr; value@@T1@@\.src: Current window → value —

@@T0@@Set $K=2$, $S=2$.@@T1@@ This is th.zh:
@@T0@@设置 $K=2$、$S=2$。@@T1@@ 这是经典的池化层：它将每个
      空间维度减半，把 $6\times6$ 变为无重叠的 $3\times3$。现在在同一个窗口上
      于 @@T2@@最大值@@T3@@ 与 @@T4@@平均值@@T5@@ 之间切换，观察所产生的数值
      如何变化 — 最大值报告单个最强的响应，平均值则报告均值。
@@T0@@Set $K=2$, $S=2$.@@T1@@ This is th.src: Set $K=2$, $S=2$. This is the classic pooling layer: it halves each spatial dimension, turning $6\times6$ into $3\times3$ with no overlap. Now switch to Max versus Average on the same window and watch the produced number change — max reports the single strongest response, average reports the mean.

@@T0@@Downsampling.@@T1@@ Pooling shrink.zh: @@T0@@下采样。@@T1@@ 池化缩小特征图，使后续层看到更粗糙、更廉价的表示。当 $K=S=2$ 时，你一步便丢弃了四分之三的激活。
@@T0@@Downsampling.@@T1@@ Pooling shrink.src: Downsampling. Pooling shrinks the feature map so later layers see a coarser, cheaper representation. With $K=S=2$ you drop three-quarters of the activations in one step.

@@T0@@Max keeps the strongest signal.@@T.zh: @@T0@@最大值保留最强信号。@@T1@@ 若某个滤波器在窗口内任意位置被激活，最大池化便会将该响应传递出去 — 免费获得一定程度的平移不变性。标有星号的格子便是“胜出”的那一个。
@@T0@@Max keeps the strongest signal.@@T.src: Max keeps the strongest signal. If a filter fires anywhere in the window, max-pool passes that response through — a small amount of translation invariance for free. The starred cell is the one that "wins".

@@T0@@Average smooths.@@T1@@ Average-poo.zh: @@T0@@平均值起平滑作用。@@T1@@ 平均池化对每个格子等同地加权混合，这能抑制噪声，却可能抹平尖锐而局部的激活。网络最末端的全局平均池化，就是作用于整张特征图的平均池化。
@@T0@@Average smooths.@@T1@@ Average-poo.src: Average smooths. Average-pool blends every cell equally, which suppresses noise but can wash out a sharp, localised activation. Global average pooling at the very end of a network is average-pool taken to the whole feature map.

@@T0@@No parameters.@@T1@@ Pooling has n.zh: @@T0@@无参数。@@T1@@ 池化没有任何需要学习的内容 — 它是一种固定的归约运算。这使它代价低廉，也正是当许多现代网络希望下采样可学习时，改用步长为 2 的卷积来替代它的原因。
@@T0@@No parameters.@@T1@@ Pooling has n.src: No parameters. Pooling has nothing to learn — it is a fixed reduction. That is why it is cheap, and why many modern nets replace it with stride-2 convolutions when they want the downsampling to be learnable.

@@T0@@Read the formula as a count.@@T1@@.zh:
@@T0@@把公式读作计数。@@T1@@ 从位置 $0$ 开始，每步将
      窗口推进 $S$；只要窗口的远端边缘仍在特征图内，它就能放下。
      停留次数恰为 $\lfloor (W-K)/S \rfloor + 1$ — 与
      卷积的形状公式相同，只是填充 $P=0$。
@@T0@@Read the formula as a count.@@T1@@.src: Read the formula as a count. Starting at position $0$, each step advances the window by $S$; it fits as long as the window's far edge stays inside the map. The number of landings is exactly $\lfloor (W-K)/S \rfloor + 1$ — the same shape formula as convolution, just with padding $P=0$.

meta.title: 池化：逐格解析
meta.tagline: 在特征图上滑动池化窗口，实时观察最大值与平均值如何将其下采样
meta.summary: 一个 6x6 的特征图，配以逐个格子滑动的池化窗口。选择窗口尺寸（2 或 3）、步长，以及最大值或平均值池化，然后逐步或连续播放在每次停留处的变化。当前窗口在输入上高亮，其产生的数值在输出上带描边，最大值模式下胜出的格子标有星号。输出尺寸公式 floor((W-K)/S)+1 实时更新，使缩小过程不再出乎意料。
highlights: 观察池化窗口在 6x6 特征图上滑动，每次停留产生一个输出格。
在同一个窗口上切换最大值与平均值池化，精确观察汇总所得的数值如何变化。
最大值模式下，唯一胜出的输入格子标有星号，使平移不变性变得具体可感。
改变窗口尺寸与步长，直接从 floor((W-K)/S)+1 读出输出维度。
步进、播放、拖动或重新生成输入，以建立关于为何 K=S=2 会使每个空间维度减半的直觉。
